ModMetaData.name: Local Early Fixes
ModMetaData.author: micro
ModMetaData.description:
Companion to Local C# Fixes for patches that MUST be applied before other mods' Mod constructors run.
Local C# Fixes uses [StaticConstructorOnStartup], which runs after defs are loaded - far too late to prevent a type initialiser from failing during CreateModClasses. This mod uses a Mod subclass instead, so its constructor runs during CreateModClasses, and it MUST sit near the top of the load order (immediately after the official DLCs, before any content mod).
Currently fixes: VFEPirates.PawnsArrivalModeWorker_Gauntlet type-initialiser failure, which also aborts Coventech Mechsuit Framework's mod instantiation.
